title: Data Modernization for a Global FMCG Leader
blurb: Transformed chaotic Excel-based forecasting workflows into streamlined, automated systems, reducing processing time from one week to three hours.
result: Processing time cut from one week to three hours

meta.industry: FMCG, supply chain and demand forecasting

whoFor: Large FMCG organizations whose forecasting still runs on sprawling, manually maintained spreadsheets that only a handful of people understand well enough to trust.
challengeIntro: Forecasting at scale had come to depend on an intricate web of Excel workbooks, each maintained by people who understood their own piece but not necessarily how it connected to everyone else's. Every forecasting cycle meant days of manual reconciliation before anyone could trust the numbers enough to act on them.
challengePoints: Forecasting processes lived across many disconnected Excel workbooks.
Manual reconciliation consumed most of a week every cycle.
Institutional knowledge about the process was concentrated in a few people.
Errors were hard to catch until well after they had already propagated.
identifiedIntro: The underlying issue was not the forecasting logic itself, it was that the logic lived in spreadsheets instead of a system, which made it slow, fragile, and dependent on specific people being available.
builtIntro: Covison replaced the manual workflow with a streamlined, automated forecasting system, covering:
builtPoints: Consolidation of the scattered Excel-based inputs
Automated processing in place of manual reconciliation
A repeatable pipeline that does not depend on one person's spreadsheet
whyNotOffTheShelf: Off-the-shelf forecasting software would have meant replacing years of organization-specific logic rather than automating it. The faster, lower-risk path was to systematize the existing process, not discard it.
productionReality: Deployed as the organization's standing forecasting process, not a side project.
Reduced dependency on specific individuals to run the cycle.
Built to be maintained by the team going forward.
outcomeBullets: Processing time cut from one week to three hours.
Forecasting no longer bottlenecked on a small group of spreadsheet owners.
Freed up a full week of team capacity every cycle for analysis instead of reconciliation.
